static_traits.name: Xia Kening
static_traits.family_status: Strained relationships with family members and estrangement
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;has not yet received psychotherapy in the past
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but hopeful; highly cooperative; can express clearly and coherently

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling disappointed with daily life, often daydreaming about becoming an animal or living in space; these thoughts make me think I should not pursue marriage and childbearing.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to understand why I have this feeling, and see whether there is anything that can be changed.
growth_experiences: In adolescence, first developed intense disappointment with daily life due to family conflicts and Academic pressure; this feeling continued into adulthood, recurring when family stress or conflicts intensified.
Long-term Tension and estrangement in family relationships, lacking strong Social support, affecting interpersonal interaction and emotional security.

core_beliefs: Ordinary life will not bring fulfillment
Entering marriage and childbearing will confine me and make me lose Freedom
I am out of step with society's traditional expectations

special_situations.event: Seeing traditional family units (such as couples traveling with children) or encountering social expectations about marriage and childbearing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I enter this traditional family role, I will lose Freedom and self
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids topics of intimate relationships and marriage/childbearing; escapes reality through daydreams (becoming an animal / life in space)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Such a life is a trap; I will lose Freedom

special_situations.event: In daily life, faces trivial routine matters (self-care, housework, work/job hunting)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If these routine matters cannot bring me significant happiness, it means ordinary life is essentially meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces investment and self-care; immerses in sci-fi/space themes to gain temporary comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Ordinary life has no meaning; doing these things is just wasting life

special_situations.event: Hears others discuss or imply social norms such as 'one should marry and have children'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not follow these 'shoulds', it proves I am not normal and have no belonging
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using 'I should not marry and have children' to establish self-rules and keep distance from the mainstream; avoiding related conversations with family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should not marry and have children; this is not a life that belongs to me

special_situations.event: Recalling experiences from the period of family conflicts and Academic pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If past stress persists, the future will not improve either, and the traditional path will only add to the pain
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using idealized fantasy escape (space/animals) to offset powerlessness; not actively seeking real-world change strategies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My future will be as disappointing as the past

core_conflict.wish: Longing to keep Freedom and self-choice, to be understood and accepted without having to meet traditional expectations
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being swallowed up by traditional roles, losing self and Freedom, being judged as 'not normal'
defense_goal: Ensures a sense of autonomy by maintaining distance and avoiding marriage and childbearing
Buffering real-world pressure and disappointment with Fantasy/daydreams

object_relations.self_representation: A misunderstood outsider, out of step with the mainstream
object_relations.object_representation: Society and traditional family roles are Freedom-restricting judges/controllers

object_relations.self_representation: An exhausted and unsupported daughter amid family conflicts
object_relations.object_representation: A tense, conflict-filled family that struggles to provide support

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing topics of marriage, childbearing, or following social norms
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously viewing others/society as controllers who would force one into traditional roles (transference: projecting past family pressure onto present relationships)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Shifting to talk about space, sci-fi and other topics in a detached, downplaying tone, reducing emotional involvement, emphasizing the value words 'Freedom''not being bound'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites me to concretize a realistic change plan or conduct routine activity monitoring
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understands exploring real change as being forced to conform to convention, thus feeling controlled and losing autonomy
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using structured Interpretation to emphasize 'such a life has no meaning''I am not suited', avoiding action commitments with rational reasons; tone calm, words abstract.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about details of emotional experience and focusing on present feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will invite judgment or demands to change
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objectified descriptions, reducing first-person emotional words, keeping a steady tone and avoiding details.

manifestations: Viewing marriage and childbearing as a 'trap' and a life of 'losing Freedom'
Developing intense discomfort and avoidance when seeing traditional family and social expectations
Tending to maintain a sense of Freedom through Fantasy (becoming an animal/living in space)
outcomes: Avoiding intimate relationships and future planning

manifestations: Lacks enjoyment and satisfaction in ordinary life and routine matters
Difficulty finding a sense of value in daily activities
Social expectations experienced as hollow or oppressive

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: When touching on topics of marriage/childbearing/traditional life, turns instead to talking about space, science fiction, or idealized escape
Using Fantasy to avoid directly feeling disappointment and Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Believing oneself 'not normal', being harsh on self-worth
When discussing realistic change, worries excessively about losing autonomy, cautious and hesitant

exception_events.target_problem: When facing routine matters like daily chores and self-care, the client usually feels intense disappointment and Lack of motivation, often escaping through Fantasy.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When reading sci-fi novels alone at night or watching space documentaries, she has not fallen into disappointment as usual; instead, she experienced some calm and interest, able to stay engaged for a while.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: choosing content highly matching personal interests; different situation: quiet Being alone environment, controllable tasks, fewer cues of external social expectations, hence reduced emotional load.

positive_force: Has a stable interest in science fiction and exploration themes, able to gain calm and focus in related activities
Willing to seek help with a positive attitude, willing to try observing and recording his own experiences
Expresses clearly, highly cooperative, has some self-awareness motivation
negative_force: Persistent disappointment and sense of Meaninglessness, emotional reasoning Reinforcing negative beliefs
Using Fantasy/daydreams as the main avoidance strategy, low real-world engagement
Holding rigid 'should/should not' beliefs about marriage, childbearing and social norms, fearing loss of Freedom

target_behavior.behavior: Escapes reality through daydreams (becoming an animal / life in space)
antecedent: Seeing traditional families or thinking about social expectations
Facing daily self-care and trivial matters
target_behavior.core_reason: The Fear of 'losing Freedom' in traditional life and the belief of 'ordinary life being Meaninglessness' trigger negative emotions, using Fantasy to relieve disappointment and Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome things (real-world pressure and negative emotions), gaining brief comfort
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased real-world engagement, Impaired job-seeking and daily functioning, Reinforcing negative cognition about ordinary life

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding romantic relationships and future planning
antecedent: Family / society's expectations of traditional roles
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being swallowed up by traditional roles, losing autonomy and Freedom
target_behavior.function: Maintaining a sense of security and self-boundaries, avoiding the subjective experience of being controlled
target_behavior.consequence: Weakened intimate relationships and social support, restricted future choices, intensifying Loneliness and disappointment

target_behavior.behavior: Insufficient self-care and daily task execution
antecedent: Facing repetitive tasks lacking immediate rewards
target_behavior.core_reason: The cognition of 'ordinary life being Meaninglessness' causing low motivation, avoiding investment
target_behavior.function: Avoiding draining tasks and negative emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life, impaired functioning, further Reinforcing sense of Meaninglessness and Self-denial
